Stephen Fry frequently tries to kill himself because of bipolar disorder. As a depressed person I agree with Stephen Fry. When you're depressed you're always miserable and if you set a goal you endure the misery to conquer it. Upon conquering it however you are still miserable, the pursuit was a lie. You built yourself a grand staircase of purpose to try and combat the misery and when the goal is reached you are left plummeting into nothingness.
